cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import random,itertools,importlib.util
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('s','/workspace/submission/main.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(s)
random.seed(88)
for trial in range(5000):
 m=random.randint(0,8)
 nf=random.randint(0,10)
 factors=[]
 for _ in range(nf):
  k=random.randint(1,m) if m else 0
  if not k:continue
  vs=tuple(sorted(random.sample(range(m),k)))
  vals=[random.randint(0,20) for _ in range(3**k)]
  factors.append((vs,vals))
 order=list(range(m));random.shuffle(order)
 pos=[0]*m
 for p,v in enumerate(order):pos[v]=p
 Z=s.run_ve(factors,m,pos)
 bz=0; nums=[[0,0,0] for _ in range(m)]
 for st in itertools.product(range(3),repeat=m):
  w=1
  for vs,vals in factors:
   fi=0
   for v in vs:fi=fi*3+st[v]
   w*=vals[fi]
  bz+=w
  for i,x in enumerate(st):nums[i][x]+=w
 if Z!=bz:
  print('bad z',trial,m,factors,order,Z,bz);break
 ok=True
 for i in range(m):
  for t in range(3):
   n=s.run_ve(factors,m,pos,(i,t))
   if n!=nums[i][t]:print('bad n',trial,i,t,n,nums[i][t]);ok=False;break
  if not ok:break
 if not ok:break
else:print('arbitrary VE tests passed')
